# `mise 版本`

- **用法：** `mise version [-J --json]`
- **别名：** `v`
- **效果：** 只读
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/version.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/version.rs)

Show the version of mise

Prints the version, OS, architecture, and build date, and warns when a newer
release is available. `mise --version`, `mise -V`, and `mise -v` with no
other arguments print the same line.

## 选项
- **`-J --json`** — 以 JSON 格式打印版本信息
- **`-h --help`** — 显示帮助

## 示例

Show the version

```
mise version
2026.10.4 linux-x64 (2026-10-07)
```

Also show the latest release and the build time, as JSON

```
mise version --json
```
